title: Self Identification Learning
definition: The ability of an AI to correctly identify and articulate its own identity and role.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Learning to know who you are in the world, like a child learning their name and family.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Understanding one's role, purpose, and identity within a system or context, such as an AI agent or employee.
difficulty_levels.expert: The process of an AI learning to recognize and express its own identity, capabilities, and purpose, often through exposure to and interaction with a wide range of data and environments.

extra_fields.insight: An AI's self-awareness and understanding of its own identity and role can impact its ability to function effectively within a given context.
